snippet.title: VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A city you've never seen
A story you've never heard
A totally new Virtua Fighter

Dive into a rich, cinematic single-player adventure experience that blends story-driven action with VF's signature intense combat.

This isn’t a remake. This isn't a trip down memory lane.
This is the next evolution of VIRTUA FIGHTER.

▼ VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS Official Website
https://crossroads.virtua-fighter.com/en/

▼ VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS Official X (Twitter)
https://x.com/VFCROSSROADS

▼ Official Discord Community Server
https://discord.com/invite/GvPrfJXHVg
Join us here to connect with fellow players and catch the latest news!

"Legacy"
Rap Vocals & Lyrics by El Gran Nael
Composed & Arranged by Yasuyuki Nagata
Rap Vocals Produced by Yuki Kanesaka

"Vilasapara"
Vocals by Yosh (Survive Said The Prophet)
Lyrics by nana hatori
Composed & Arranged by Makoto Tokuyama
